learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the magical connection between sounds and feelings, and learn how music can make us feel happy, sad, or excited!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Music is like a secret language that speaks directly to our hearts. Even without words, a cheerful tune can make you smile, while a slow, deep song might make you feel calm or a little sad.
The speed of the music is called tempo. Fast music makes us want to jump up and dance because it feels energetic! Slow tempo music usually feels peaceful, relaxing, or emotional.

Pitch is how high or low a sound is. High pitches like a tiny flute often sound like little chirping birds and feel happy. Low pitches like a big drum can sound like thunder and feel scary or powerful.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw the Music
fun_activity.instructions: Play your favorite fast song and draw using bright colors and quick lines. Then, play a slow lullaby and draw using cool colors and smooth, wavy lines to see how the emotions change!

quick_recap: ⭐ Music can easily change our mood and make us feel different emotions.
⭐ Tempo is the speed of music; fast means energetic and slow means calm.
⭐ Pitch tells us if a sound is high (like a whistle) or low (like a bear's growl).
⭐ You do not need lyrics to understand the feeling of a song.
